availableEvidence: The official RI.gov Board of Elections results app exposes a 2024 General Election statewide summary and city/town result pages.
The official data page lists short-format and long-format ZIP downloads, statewide JSON, General Assembly JSON, and JSON files for all 39 cities and towns.
The data page states that the raw technical files are supplied as a courtesy and that the official results are the posted Board of Elections results pages.
